text: Ergonomics: manually operated valves and controls with a handwheel centre between 0.6 m and 1.8 m above the working level (preferably 0.9 m to 1.5 m); local indicators readable between 1.0 m and 1.8 m; access clearance at least 0.8 m in front of operated equipment; the manual handling of loads above 25 kg shall be avoided by hoists, monorails or lifting lugs; equipment shall be laid out for maintenance with lay-down and lift paths agreed in the constructability and maintainability review (HS-RPT-0002).
